cases.spec_ref: `lat unpack <p.zst> out` — inverts `pack`. Each leg packs the fixture (deterministic setup) then unpacks it; the value under test is the RECOVERED AGS4 text, which must equal the original bytes on every launcher. A launcher whose unpack corrupts or truncates the zstd payload shows as a text split against the others' faithful round-trip (#555 part 2).
